cards.lore: "Admit One to the Problem. We don't solve things here; we just light them better."
cards.power: RULE: We are playing Attractions, not Diagnoses. Everything is symbolic.

cards.lore: "I'm not a healer. I'm a story-wrestler. Welcome to the mess."
cards.power: AVATAR: Acts as Narrator. Allows the player to reframe any tragedy as a comedy.

cards.lore: "Sometimes the clown gets too close. Blow this to stop the show."
cards.power: MECHANIC: Immediate safety break. Stops the session instantly.

cards.lore: "You are carrying things that no one sees. Put them on the table."
cards.power: RULE: Players must draw Rucksack Cards to start the session.

cards.lore: "In this mirror, I'm confident. In that one, I'm a fraud. Which is real? Both."
cards.power: Players must narrate contradictory self-images. No single truth allowed.

cards.lore: "There's a weight. Not sadness. Not anger. Just... heavy."
cards.power: Describe only somatic sensations (colors, textures, weights). No emotion labels.

cards.lore: "I can explain my trauma with perfect academic vocabulary."
cards.power: ZONE: Intellectualize everything until interrupted by: "Yes, but how does it FEEL?"

cards.lore: "I'm fine! Look how competent I am! (Please don't look behind the curtain)."
cards.power: ZONE: Narrate as a Performance vs. Narrate as the Backstage Reality.

cards.lore: "I keep waiting for them to say it. They never will."
cards.power: BLOCK: Forgiveness is impossible. Narrator must reference the missing closure.

cards.lore: "It's not even sharp anymore. It's just heavy. I'm used to it."
cards.power: WEIGHT: Adds weight to narration. Player cannot choose the "easy" path.

cards.lore: "If they don't like me, do I even exist?"
cards.power: FILTER: Every decision must be filtered through: "Will this make them happy?"

cards.cardName: The Promise to the Younger Self
cards.lore: "I said I'd never become this. Oops."
cards.power: RIGIDITY: The Actor cannot compromise on values, even if it hurts them.

cards.lore: "I save people who didn't ask. Then I'm angry they aren't grateful."
cards.power: COMPULSION: Actor MUST intervene in others' stories, causing complications.

cards.lore: "You get loud. I go quiet. We both disappear."
cards.power: TRIGGER: Conflict triggers silence. Player skips turn or narrates "fade to black."

cards.lore: "I am thinking about my thinking about my feelings."
cards.power: PARALYSIS: Explain the THEORY of the action but never take the action.

cards.lore: "They are a project, not a person. And I love projects."
cards.power: ATTRACTION: Actor is drawn to the most dangerous element on the Stage.

cards.lore: "I used to say no. I forgot how. Now anyone can walk in."
cards.power: COLLAPSE: Actor cannot say 'No' until another player volunteers as Gatekeeper.

cards.lore: "No one gets in. Ever. Not even me."
cards.power: RIGIDITY: Actor rejects all help/Items until isolation becomes unbearable.

cards.lore: "I'm fine. I just need to sleep for three years."
cards.power: ROLE: Gains tokens for helping, loses tokens for asking for help.

cards.lore: "You're doing it wrong. Everyone noticed."
cards.power: COMMENTARY: Another player holds this and provides running cynical commentary.

cards.cardName: Future Self: The One Who Left
cards.lore: "I left. It was hard. But I'm... lighter. And terrified."
cards.power: JUDGMENT: Hovers above Actor. Judges every choice to 'stay' or 'endure'.

cards.cardName: Future Self: The One Who Stayed
cards.lore: "I can't believe you stayed this long. It never get better."
cards.power: FAILURE: Hovers above Actor. Makes 'endurance' feel like failure.

cards.lore: "A moment where the timeline cracks."
cards.power: MECHANIC: Split the timeline. Narrate two contradictory outcomes (A and B).

cards.lore: "Measuring the gap between intent and action."
cards.power: ARTIFACT: If the gap is too wide, Actor takes psychic damage (loses turn).

cards.lore: Cognitive lag. Delayed integration.
cards.power: PAUSE: Another player must restate the revelation in the dumbest possible way.

cards.lore: Enlightenment inflation detected.
cards.power: INTERRUPT: Play if someone says "What this really means is..." Sentence ends.

cards.lore: Embodiment reminder. You have a body. Feed it.
cards.power: BREAK: Play pauses for 30 seconds. Everyone breathes. Silence. Eating.

cards.lore: Overexplained revelation.
cards.power: CONSTRAINT: Complex feelings must be explained via bullet points and hand gestures.

cards.lore: "Makes seriousness impossible."
cards.power: ACTION: Walk/talk like you're wearing giant shoes. Exaggerate the limp.

cards.lore: "Expose the con you're running on yourself."
cards.power: ACTION: Sell your trauma as a product. "Step right up! Get your avoidance here!"

cards.lore: "Secrets lose power when performed."
cards.power: ACTION: Tell the secret to the back row in a loud, dramatic whisper.

cards.lore: "You can't hold everything. That's okay."
cards.power: ACTION: Mime juggling while talking. Drop one ball. Acknowledge it.

cards.lore: "I forgot who is under it. The role became the skin."
cards.power: STUCK: Actor cannot change behavior pattern, even when falling.

cards.lore: "At least it was hard. If it was hard, it must matter."
cards.power: VALIDATION: Validates a struggle without resolving it.

cards.lore: "We talk about it. We look at it. We never walk on it."
cards.power: OBSTACLE: Defines a permanent obstacle in the relationship/story.

cards.lore: "The goalpost shift. Just when you thought you were done."
cards.power: EXTENSION: Extends the Quest difficulty just as it is about to end.

cards.lore: "Cognitive weather tracking without performance."
cards.power: SETUP: 1 Player. 5 Actors. No Quest. Just witness the patterns.

cards.lore: "The Therapist holds the frame, not the answers."
cards.power: SETUP: Therapist = Navigator. Client = Actors + Rucksack. Quest = Pattern Visibility.

cards.lore: "Externalization technique."
cards.power: TECHNIQUE: If a client feels something, put a card on table. Name it. It is now outside.

cards.lore: "Boring is progress."
cards.power: SOLO RULE: Play for 7 days. Don't fix anything. Just watch.

cards.lore: "You can't unhear it once you've voiced it."
cards.power: MECHANIC: Swap Actors. Play your partner's grievance from THEIR perspective.

cards.lore: "Roles are assigned, not chosen."
cards.power: MECHANIC: Role Rotation. When Quest Die hits 3, pass Role Card to the left.

cards.lore: "90% role dynamics, 10% actual work."
cards.power: SETUP: Zone = Rationalization Booth. Everyone explains why it's not their fault.

cards.lore: "No Refunds on Epiphanies."
cards.power: META-CARD: Use to end any dispute about rules. The house always wins.

cards.lore: "The Hall of Mirrors is a Bardo space."
cards.power: LINK: Mix with "Doors Were Never Closed". Entities speak through Carnival Barkers.

cards.lore: "Performed on the Grand Ringmaster Stage."
cards.power: LINK: Mix with "Love & Bonding". Relationship dynamics become Attractions.

cards.lore: "Someone has to clean up the epiphany."
cards.power: NPC: They arrive to end the session or "clean up" a messy narrative thread.

cards.lore: "Stay symbolic. Stay theatrical. Stay fluffy."
cards.power: CLOSING: Your problems don't need solving, they need stage lighting.
